annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: × Incorrect nth-term formula used (aₙ = a + nd instead of a + (n − 1)d).
× Evaluated using the incorrect formula a + 8d instead of a + 7d.

annotatedSteps.description: Formula statement and substitution for total distance of 10 rounds
annotatedSteps.studentWork:
(iii)(a) Before finding the sum I checked my formula: with aₙ = a + nd the first round would be a₁ = 300 + 50 = 350 m, but the first round is 300 m. So aₙ = a + nd is wrong; the correct formula is aₙ = a + (n − 1)d. I will use the correct formula from here.
S₁₀ = (10/2)[2 × 300 + (10 − 1) × 50]
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ✓ Correctly identified the conceptual error and substituted correctly into the sum formula.

annotatedSteps.description: Compute the total sum S₁₀ with unit

teacherNote: Great job spotting the formula error yourself in part (iii) and correctly calculating the total sum! Remember to go back and update parts (i) and (ii) whenever you self-correct during an exam, as the nth term of an AP is aₙ = a + (n − 1)d.

rubric.point: (i) Calculate fourth, fifth and sixth terms: a₄ = 450 m, a₅ = 500 m, a₆ = 550 m
(ii) Determine distance of 8th round: a₈ = a + 7d = 650 m
(iii)(a) State sum formula Sₙ = n/2[2a + (n - 1)d] and substitute values
(iii)(a) Evaluate total distance run: S₁₀ = 5250 m
